name: Bachelor in International Hospitality Management
about: A preparatory year of hands-on service and kitchen training, then business foundations, two six-month internships (operations and administration), an optional Singapore semester and a final-year specialisation such as luxury marketing or finance and real estate.

name: Bachelor of Business Administration
about: A broad business degree from project management and data analysis to branding and digital communication, with an internship, the chance to move between EU campuses and a summer fast track.

name: Bachelor of Arts in International Relations
about: The interplay of politics, economics and culture across borders, from geopolitics and conflict to policy strategy and diplomatic negotiation, studied in Geneva with an internship.

name: Bachelor of Arts in Artificial Intelligence for Business
about: Machine learning, data analytics and automation applied to business processes and strategy, aimed at leading AI-driven change in companies, with an internship.

name: Bachelor of Arts in Sports Management
about: The business side of sport: sponsorship, negotiation, communication, finance, logistics and digital change in the sports industry, e-sports included, with an internship.

name: Bachelor of Arts in Digital Business, Design & Innovation
about: User-centred digital design and entrepreneurship for leading digital transformation, brand and change management, with an internship.

name: Bachelor of Arts in Leisure & Tourism Management
about: Service quality, event management and sustainable tourism, with business models and financial analysis for travel and leisure, an internship and exchanges with sister schools in Paris, Bordeaux, Lyon, Monaco and London.

name: Bachelor of Science in Business Finance
about: Financial institutions and instruments, risk management, profitability and financial data analysis on an ethical footing, aimed at banking, accountancy and business intelligence, with an internship.

name: Health Sciences
about: Biology, chemistry, psychology and public health in one degree, covering the standard pre-med coursework US and Canadian medical schools ask for, with Academic Travel built into every semester.

name: International Relations
about: Core courses in political science, sociology and history, plus languages, cultural studies, economics or communications, to analyse global issues for careers in diplomacy, international organizations, business, journalism or law.

name: Environmental Sciences and Studies
about: Two routes: a BS rooted in ecology, biology, chemistry, physics and field work, or a BA that links environmental science with social sciences and humanities. Both can include a School for Field Studies semester.

name: Major in Business Administration (BWL)
about: Marketing, strategic management, corporate finance and accounting, with statistics, an introduction to computer science and compulsory economics and law courses, taken after the English-track Assessment Year.

name: Major in Economics (VWL)
about: Micro- and macroeconomics applied to real questions (crises, growth, pensions, minimum wages, pricing), with modern data-analysis methods, small course groups and room to set your own focus.

name: Major in International Affairs (BIA)
about: Political science, economics, business administration and law combined to understand how states and markets interact, with exchange semesters, internships and courses aimed at careers between the public and private sectors.

name: Bachelor of Science in Informatics
about: Software design and architecture, modelling of complex systems and systems thinking, with theory paired with sizeable projects and lab work, an internship and a bachelor project, in a faculty founded in 2004.

name: Bachelor in Data Science
about: Statistics, mathematics and programming applied to real domains, run jointly by the informatics and economics faculties, with a stream in Informatics or in Finance and Economics.

name: Bachelor in Economics (English track)
about: Management, finance, micro- and macroeconomics, quantitative methods and law in a common core taught in English or Italian, then a specialisation in management, finance, political economy or quantitative methods.

name: International Relations
about: Global politics, human rights, geopolitical tensions and migration, taught minutes from the UN district by professors and practitioners, with guest speakers from international bodies and field trips to Geneva agencies.

name: Finance
about: From basic finance to advanced investments and financial management, for careers in banking, financial services and international organizations, with course visits to banks, insurers and bodies such as the WTO.

name: Computer Science
about: Software development, algorithms and data structures, operating systems and networks, with maths and hands-on training. An emphasis in cybersecurity adds network security, ethical hacking and defence.

name: Bachelor in Business Administration (BBA)
about: A broad business degree in management, marketing, operations, accounting and finance, taught with students from over 60 countries; in year three you specialise in Finance, International Business or Shipping Management.

name: Bachelor in Data Science for Business
credential: Bachelor of Data Science for Business
about: Business subjects (accounting, economics, finance, management) joined to statistics, machine learning and Python programming for data analysis and visualisation, with a course in AI and data ethics.

name: Bachelor in Digital Business
about: Digital innovation, AI, automation and cloud solutions studied alongside economics, marketing, strategy and leadership, with project work on real problems and courses such as low-code software development and digital business law.

name: Bachelor in Game Art and Animation
about: Art for games made with studio tools, specialising from the second semester as a game animator, 3D artist, 2D concept artist or technical artist, and building real games every semester with the game technology students.

name: Bachelor in Game Technology
about: Programming for games and interactive media, in teams with artists and designers from the first semester; from year two you specialise in game programming (engines, mechanics, networking) or computer graphics (3D, shaders, simulation).

name: Bachelor's Programme in Classical Ballet
about: Daily ballet class with classical and newer repertoire, pointe work and pas de deux, plus choreography, modern dance and health, taught in small groups in close cooperation with the Norwegian National Ballet.

name: Bachelor in Business, Economics and Data Science
about: Business administration and economics with more maths, applied statistics, programming, automation and AI than a standard business degree; each semester is built around a theme such as consumers, the firm, markets or sustainability.

name: International Environment and Development Studies
about: Social justice, sustainability, natural resource management, resource conflicts and development policy studied together, with a field course in India or Tanzania and an optional exchange in the fifth semester.

name: Bachelor of Biology
about: Physiology, genetics, species diversity, ecology and evolution, with weight on marine and cell biology; lab work, field courses in northern Norway and trips on the research vessel PIA, with a lot of compulsory attendance.

name: Bachelor of Animal Science
about: Three semesters of animal biology, chemistry and animal science in Bodø, then three at the veterinary university UVMP in Košice, Slovakia, with a guaranteed place on its veterinary medicine programme afterwards.

name: Film and TV Production
about: Every stage of film and TV production, from storytelling and directing to camera, sound and editing, with a focus on new media and making good work on small budgets through clever use of technology.

name: Bachelor in CG Art and Animation
about: Digital art and animation made with industry-standard tools, in studios also used for filmmaking, game development and interactive media, learning in teams the way a production studio works.

name: Bachelor in Games and Entertainment Technology
about: How to make video games and other entertainment and learning products: programming, game design and ludology, traditional art, 3D assets, animation and sound, with project management and gaming ethics.

name: Bachelor in Acting and Artistic Production
about: Ensemble-based training in acting, movement, voice, singing and music for theatre, film and other media, with visiting artists and your own productions; a study trip abroad is possible in year three.

name: Academic Esports
about: Esports as the way into training and performance, physiology and psychology, marketing, economics, content production and game technology; the last semester specialises in play, industry, innovation or education and health.

name: Classical Music Performance
about: Performance on a classical main instrument, or two main areas across genres, with solo repertoire, orchestra, choir and chamber music, plus aural training, music history, analysis and music technology.

name: Electronic Music
about: Music production, sound design, composition and arranging with electronic music theory and history, from electronic pop and club music to live electronics, ambient and experimental work, with one-to-one supervision.

name: English
about: English language, literature and culture of Britain and the USA, with training in close analysis and academic writing and a study trip to York in the first spring semester. Taught in English and Norwegian.

name: Global Development Studies
about: Development, international relations and global change from an interdisciplinary social-science angle, with a fourth semester on exchange and final-semester fieldwork with partner universities in developing countries.

name: Technology Systems: Science and Engineering
about: How to design and build complex technology systems, in renewable energy, space, robotics, cybersecurity or health technology, through labs and projects that link engineering with social science, law and the humanities; 30 credits are yours to choose.

name: Dance – Bachelor
about: Contemporary dance: daily technique training, improvisation and dance-making, with many chances to perform, yearly guest artists and a fifth semester abroad at a partner school or on your own project.

name: Bachelor's Program in Business and Economics
about: Business administration, economics, statistics and commercial law first, then a major in business administration, economics or financial economics, with eight specialisations and a semester abroad in year three.

name: Bachelor's Program in Computer Science and AI
about: Two parallel tracks, computer science and AI, built on mathematics and analytical thinking from day one; taught mainly on Chalmers' Johanneberg campus. First intake in autumn 2027.

name: Bachelor's Program in International Relations
about: International structures and conflicts, global inequality and environmental change, with training to analyse and evaluate global challenges; taught at the School of Global Studies in central Gothenburg.

name: Bachelor's Program in Software Engineering and Management
about: Software engineering with a management angle: team projects with industry partners and hackathons, taught at Lindholmen Science Park, Gothenburg's technology hub.

name: Bachelor of Fine Arts in Contemporary Traditions in Music
about: For musicians from folk, traditional or world music, or non-Western art music such as Arabic or Indian classical: ensemble playing and projects that cross traditions.

name: Bachelor's Programme in Music, with a specialization in Classical Performance
about: Instrumental study, chamber music, ensemble and orchestra on your instrument, with individual tuition in English or Swedish, preparing you for orchestra and freelance work.

name: Bachelor's Programme in Music, with a specialization in Improvisation Performance
about: For any instrument: develop your own improvising style and compositions, with yearly joint projects with the music academies in Oslo and Tallinn. Taught in English and Swedish.

name: Bachelor of Fine Arts in Opera
about: Vocal training at the core, with drama and movement, at least one staged project a year and a great deal of individual coaching towards a career as an opera singer.

name: BFA Programme in Craft with Specialisation in Crafting Futures
about: Craft between fine art and design at rural Campus Steneby in Dalsland: work across wood, metal, textiles, clay and a 3D lab, exploring materials, place and landscape.

name: BFA Programme in Metal Art
about: Forging, fabrication, welding, sheet-metal forming and casting in a 1,200 m² metal workshop at Campus Steneby, Dals Långed, 170 km north of Gothenburg.

name: BFA Programme in Wood Oriented Furniture Design
about: Furniture design through project modules with an exploratory, material-led approach, plus materials, techniques and design method, in Campus Steneby's wood workshops.

name: Bachelor in International Economics
about: A shared first year in business and economics, then international trade, financial markets and econometrics with large datasets and AI-supported analysis; a semester abroad or internship in year three.

name: Bachelor in International Management
about: A shared first year in business and economics, then international management: entrepreneurship, leadership, strategy, change and supply chains, with a semester abroad or an internship.

name: Bachelor in International Marketing
about: A shared first year in business and economics, then marketing: consumer behaviour, branding, digital marketing, market research and SEO, with data-driven tools and a semester abroad option.

name: Graphic Design and Web Development
about: Graphic design, programming and web design combined with digital marketing and UX design: you learn to design and code interactive web applications and to make graphics for print and screen.

name: Industrial Engineering and Management: Sustainable Supply Chain Management
about: Industrial economics and organisation focused on sustainable supply chains: logistics, purchasing, lean, quality management, transport, warehousing and simulation.

name: Mechanical Engineering (BSc)
about: Mechanical engineering, materials and product development, designing complex systems in teams from day one with CAD, simulation and real industry challenges.

name: Prosthetics and Orthotics, BSc
about: Train as a prosthetist and orthotist: medical knowledge, technology and patient work combined to design and fit prostheses and orthoses, moving from classroom to clinic.

name: Bachelor's Programme in Biomedicine
about: The biology and pathology of the human body, lab training and an introduction to basic and translational research, taught by active researchers; the degree project can be done in Sweden or abroad.

name: Information and Communication Technology
about: Electronics, programming, computer science and communication technology, joined with economics, leadership and sustainability; much of the work is labs and group projects, all taught in English.

name: Bachelor's Programme in Experimental and Industrial Biomedicine
about: Cell and molecular biology, biochemistry, physiology and pharmacology alongside drug discovery, bioinformatics and digital pathology, with project courses in bioentrepreneurship and a research semester.

name: Computer Game Development and Programming
about: Game programming, from AI and physics programming to engines and graphics, alongside creative team projects that build complete games, on LTU's games campus in Skellefteå.

name: Bachelor Programme in Computer Graphics for Games and Film
about: Traditional art exercises first, then 2D digital compositing for film effects, 3D modelling, animation and rendering, with client-led team projects and a programming course.

name: Bachelor Programme in Computer Game Design
about: Turn ideas into playable prototypes and finished games through playtesting and iteration, working in teams with the programming and graphics students. New in 2027.

name: Bachelor Programme in Mineral Resource Engineering
about: The whole mineral value chain, from finding ore to extraction, processing, recycling and waste, with maths, physics, chemistry and geoscience and projects run with mining companies.

name: Bachelor Programme in Music (Classical Musician, Composition, Church Music)
about: Classical performance, composition or church music in Piteå, with concert halls and studios to perform and record in and an artistic research project in the third year.

name: Biomedicine
about: Medicine, science and lab skills together, studying diseases such as cancer and diabetes with active researchers, in an environment built around current research.

name: Economy and Society
about: How economies and societies change over time, with the tools to analyse global development and act in a world of constant transformation; alumni work in policy, sustainability and consulting.

name: Sciences, Mathematics
about: Mathematics, mathematical statistics, numerical analysis and computational science, combinable with science, engineering, economics or humanities courses; half the places are for international admission.

name: Sciences, Physics
about: Mechanics, electromagnetism, quantum mechanics and thermodynamics with maths and programming, then applied areas from particle to astrophysics, with much lab and project work.

name: Sciences, Physical Geography and Ecosystem Science
about: Soil, water, biosphere and atmosphere and how they interact with people, with GIS, remote sensing, climate modelling, fieldwork and excursions.

name: European Studies - Politics, Societies and Cultures, Bachelor's Programme
about: Europe and the EU past and present, and their place in the world, studied through political science, history, geography, law, culture and literature.

name: Human Rights
about: What human rights are and how they are interpreted and used in law, politics and philosophy: how they are enforced and monitored, and how conflicts between rights are resolved.

name: Interaction Design
about: Designing experiences with products, services and environments that are useful and usable but also expressive and desirable, building a repertoire of design methods, skills and theory.

name: International Migration and Ethnic Relations
about: Global migration and migration policy, refugees and asylum law, segregation, discrimination, integration and social cohesion, preparing you for work on migration and diversity.

name: International Relations
about: Analyse current world politics: peace and security, cooperation and conflict, foreign policy and aid, with a semester kept free for exchange, an internship or other courses.

name: Peace and Conflict Studies
about: Why armed conflict and organised violence arise and how they end, from systemic to grassroots views, drawing on political science, history, law, anthropology and philosophy.

name: Forest and Landscape (BSc)
about: Forestry science and landscape architecture together: how forest landscapes are maintained, experienced and managed, on SLU's park campus in Alnarp near Malmö and Lund, with a Wageningen double-degree option.

name: Business and Economics
about: Three semesters of shared courses (accounting, law, data analytics, economics, finance, management, marketing, strategy), then your own mix of specialisations, electives and exchange or internship.

name: Retail Management
about: Business economics applied to retail and consumer business, with an Applied Retail Track of live cases run with companies such as H&M, ICA and Systembolaget, in a class of 60.

name: Bachelor's Programme in International Business and Politics
about: Business administration with political science, economic history and international political economy: a first year at Stockholm Business School, then politics and history, then exchange or electives.

name: Bachelor’s Programme in Business, Ethics and Sustainability
about: Business studies combined with practical philosophy (including ethics) and sustainability science, for careers in business, the public sector and NGOs.

name: International Bachelor's Programme in Political Science and Regional Studies
about: A first year of political science, then a regional specialisation in year two, and an internship, economic history or study abroad in year three.

name: Bachelor's Programme in Latin American Studies with specialization in Spanish
about: The history, politics, economics and culture of Latin America, the Caribbean and the Hispanic USA, with Spanish, and an optional Latin America-focused internship.

name: Bachelor's Programme in Latin American Studies with specialization in Portuguese
about: The history, politics, economics and culture of Latin America, the Caribbean and the Hispanic USA, with Portuguese, and an optional internship in Latin America.

name: Bachelor's Programme in Middle Eastern and North African Studies
about: The early and modern history of the Middle East and North Africa, its religions, literature and culture, and its political and economic development, with a focus on today's societies.

name: Bachelor's Programme in Earth Science, Distance Learning
about: Minerals and rocks, plate tectonics, climate, landscapes and natural resources, studied mostly online at your own pace, plus three compulsory intensive lab and field courses.

name: Bachelor Programme in Industrial Design
about: Industrial design from sketching and prototyping to interaction, systems and service design, in industry-like studios with your own workspace and projects run with outside partners.

name: Bachelor of Science Programme in Life Science
about: Chemistry and molecular biology to understand how life works at the molecular level, with lab work on modern equipment and a specialisation in either chemistry or molecular biology.

name: International Business and Economics Programme
credential: Bachelor of Science in Business and Economics
about: Business and economics from a global perspective, with data analysis and visualisation, managing innovation and change across borders, and exchange studies or an internship.

name: Architecture Programme
about: A five-year, practice-based architecture education at Umeå School of Architecture, combining artistic and scientific work with a steady focus on sustainable, socially just cities and buildings.

name: Bachelor's Programme in Egyptology
about: The material culture, archaeology and texts of ancient Egypt, learning to read ancient Egyptian, combined with Assyriology to set Egypt among the cultures of the Near East.

name: Bachelor's Programme in Energy Transition – Sustainability and Leadership
about: Several disciplines brought together to tackle energy transitions, climate and energy security, with training to lead change towards a sustainable energy system, on Campus Gotland.

name: Bachelor's Programme in Game Design and Graphics
about: Making art for games, from 2D game graphics on to 3D, with game development for commercial production and the study of how games work and affect players, on Campus Gotland.

name: Bachelor's Programme in Game Design and Level Design
about: Building engaging game worlds by combining technology, design and art, to work as a level designer in the professional, international games industry, on Campus Gotland.

name: Bachelor's Programme in Game Design and Programming
about: The technical side of game development, with C++ programming at its core, to build games and new experiences professionally, on Campus Gotland in Visby.

name: Bachelor's Programme in Game Design and Project Management
about: Planning and leading game projects from idea to launch: team leadership and tools to plan and assess productions, alongside hands-on game development, on Campus Gotland.

name: Bachelor's Programme in Holocaust and Genocide Studies
about: Historical and present-day cases of genocide, mass violence and crimes against humanity, examined in a field taught entirely in English in Uppsala.

name: Bachelor's Programme in Leadership – Quality Management – Improvement
about: Leadership, quality management and business development from a long-term social, ecological and economic sustainability perspective, on Campus Gotland in Visby.
